say:0:1221002001:0.text: ...Even stranded on a deserted island, the gangs are still at each other's throats.
say:0:1221002001:0.source_cn: ……都流落到无人岛上了，血薇帮和水鬼帮怎么还在吵架。

say:1:1221002002:0.text: Let's head over and see, and hope nothing gets out of hand.
say:1:1221002002:0.source_cn: 我们过去看看吧，但愿别出什么乱子。

say:1:1221003001:0.text: Stop it! Stop fighting! We're all marooned on this desolate island, so we need to band together!
say:1:1221003001:0.source_cn: 停、停！别吵了！大家都流落到荒岛上了，应该好好相处，互...

say:3:1221003002:1.text:
Band together?!
Hmph! The Whispers are fixing the ship for the Wights, but what's he doing?!
say:3:1221003002:1.source_cn: 互相帮助？！\n哼！我们血薇帮倒是在帮水鬼帮修船，可他...

say:4:1221003003:0.text: He dared to use this opportunity for revenge, and on an injured person no less!
say:4:1221003003:0.source_cn: ——他居然趁机报复，还报复在伤员身上！

say:7:1221003005:0.text: Don't measure me by your own moral compass! No matter how much I despise you, I would never target an unconscious person!
say:7:1221003005:0.source_cn: 别拿你的道德底线来评判我！就算我再怎么敌视你们，也不会...

say:8:1221003006:0.text: Is that right? Then explain how Elwood vanished from right out under your nose!
say:8:1221003006:0.source_cn: 你没有？那你倒是说说，埃尔伍是怎么从你眼皮底下消失的？！

say:9:1221003007:0.text: We trusted you to look after Elwood because you seemed dependable. When we returned from gathering herbs, he was gone! How is this not your fault?!
say:9:1221003007:0.source_cn: 我们看你老实，才把埃尔伍交给你来照顾。结果等我们采药回...

say:10:1221003008:0.text: I've already been through this with you! The injured man was delirious and rambling about water, so I went to fetch him some.
say:10:1221003008:0.source_cn: 都和你们解释好几遍了，是伤员一直迷迷糊糊地要水喝，我只...

say:11:1221003009:0.text: When I returned, I couldn't believe my eyes... A group of <style="highlight">strange, walking plants</style> was carrying the injured man off into the forest!
say:11:1221003009:0.source_cn: 我也没想到，回来的时候居然看到……看到一群<style...

choice_prompt:12:1221003009.text: When I returned, I couldn't believe my eyes... A group of <style="highlight">strange, walking plants</style> was carrying the injured man off into the forest!
choice_prompt:12:1221003009.source_cn: 我也没想到，回来的时候居然看到……看到一群<style=highlight>长着腿的奇怪植物</style>，抬着伤员的担架跑进森林了！

say:13:1221003010:0.text: Indeed, I'd never seen anything like it before!
say:13:1221003010:0.source_cn: 是啊，我从来没见过那样的东西！
say:13:1221003010:0.male: Indeed, I'd never seen anything like it before!
say:13:1221003010:0.female: Indeed, I'd never seen anything like it before!

say:14:1221003011:0.text: And they were fast! They were far out of my sight before I had a chance to pursue them!
say:14:1221003011:0.source_cn: 而且它们跑得飞快，一眨眼就不见了，我甚至都没来得及追。
say:14:1221003011:0.male: And they were fast! They were far out of my sight before I had a chance to pursue them!
say:14:1221003011:0.female: And they were fast! They were far out of my sight before I had a chance to pursue them!

say:15:1221003013:1.text: Pah! Don't try to pull the wool over my eyes! I've spent a lifetime at sea and I've never heard of such a creature!
say:15:1221003013:1.source_cn: 呸！少骗人了！我跟船出海这么多年，经验不知道比你多多少...

say:16:1221003014:0.text: Now tell us where you've hidden Elwood!
say:16:1221003014:0.source_cn: 快说，你把埃尔伍藏哪去了！

say:17:1221003015:0.text: No matter how rotten you think we are, we'd never stoop that low!
say:17:1221003015:0.source_cn: ——就算我们再混蛋，也不会报复一个重伤的人！

say:18:1221003016:0.text:
You don't believe me, do you?
Then I'll go find him myself!
say:18:1221003016:0.source_cn: 你们不信是吧？\n那我自己去找！

say:21:1221003012:0.text: Magister, from what he's describing, could they be glimmerblooms?
say:21:1221003012:0.source_cn: 主人，听他的描述，该不会是荧荧花吧……
say:21:1221003012:0.male: Magister, from what he's describing, could they be glimmerblooms?
say:21:1221003012:0.female: Magister, from what he's describing, could they be glimmerblooms?

say:0:1221004001:0.text: That Water Wight sounded like he was telling the truth... let's go see for ourselves!
say:0:1221004001:0.source_cn: 那个水鬼帮成员说的不像是假话……我们先跟上去看看吧！

say:0:1221006001:0.text: The glimmerblooms really can carry people off!
say:0:1221006001:0.source_cn: 那些荧荧花居然真的把人扛走了……！

say:1:1221006002:0.text: Let's follow them and stage a rescue!
say:1:1221006002:0.source_cn: 先跟上去，想办法救人吧！

say:0:1221007001:0.text: There's a split in the path ahead, which way did they go?
say:0:1221007001:0.source_cn: 前面是个岔路口，他们往哪边走了？

say:1:1221007002:0.text: There are some marks on the left side, possibly left by them.
say:1:1221007002:0.source_cn: 左边的地上好像有一些痕迹，说不定是它们留下的。

say:0:1221008001:0.text: Looks like these tracks were left by the glimmerblooms' petals. Let's press on.
say:0:1221008001:0.source_cn: 看起来是荧荧花走路时叶片拖出来的痕迹。继续往前吧。
say:0:1221008001:0.male: Looks like these tracks were left by the glimmerblooms' petals. Let's press on.
say:0:1221008001:0.female: Looks like these tracks were left by the glimmerblooms' petals. Let's press on.

say:0:1221009001:0.text: Wait! It seems the glimmerblooms led the Water Wight to the missing injured person!
say:0:1221009001:0.source_cn: 等等！荧荧花似乎……带水鬼帮找到了那个消失的伤员！

say:1:1221011001:0.text: Do you see this?! His wounds have all been healed, with not even a scar left!
say:1:1221011001:0.source_cn: 你们看到了吗？！伤员身上的伤口全都愈合了，而且一点痕迹...

say:3:1221011002:1.text: It's... it's true! Apart from still being asleep, he looks as if he was never injured at all...
say:3:1221011002:1.source_cn: 真、真的！除了还没苏醒之外，他简直就像完全没受过伤一样……

say:5:1221011004:1.text:
I'm not sure either...
These strange creatures that carried me here must be linked to this!
say:5:1221011004:1.source_cn: 我也搞不清楚……\n是这群怪家伙把我扛到这里的，说不定...

choice_prompt:6:1221011004.text:
I'm not sure either...
These strange creatures that carried me here must be linked to this!
choice_prompt:6:1221011004.source_cn: 我也搞不清楚……\n是这群怪家伙把我扛到这里的，说不定这事和它们有关！

say:7:1221011005:0.text: Doesn't matter what they are. I bet they healed the injured man by some strange means to lure us in! This could be a trap!
say:7:1221011005:0.source_cn: 随便它们是什么花。要我说，肯定是它们用诡异的办法治好了...
say:7:1221011005:0.male: Doesn't matter what they are. I bet they healed the injured man by some strange means to lure us in! This could be a trap!
say:7:1221011005:0.female: Doesn't matter what they are. I bet they healed the injured man by some strange means to lure us in! This could be a trap!

say:9:1221011006:0.text: But given the situation, it seems the glimmerblooms really have healed him...
say:9:1221011006:0.source_cn: 不过看现在的情况，的确是荧荧花治好了伤员……
say:9:1221011006:0.male: But given the situation, it seems the glimmerblooms really have healed him...
say:9:1221011006:0.female: But given the situation, it seems the glimmerblooms really have healed him...

say:10:1221011008:0.text: But I don't understand, why would they do this?
say:10:1221011008:0.source_cn: 可我想不明白，它们为什么要这样做？

say:11:1221011009:0.text: Why don't you ask them directly? They seem to speak human language, though I could barely understand a word...
say:11:1221011009:0.source_cn: 你、你要不直接问它们？它们好像会说人话，虽然我完全没听懂……

say:14:1221011011:0.text: ...Hold on, why are you pointing at me? What's this got to do with me?!
say:14:1221011011:0.source_cn: ……等一下，你为什么指着我？这和我有什么关系？！

say:15:1221011012:0.source_cn: 你想要，所以，荧荧花，帮你！

say:16:1221011013:0.text: I... what did I wish for?

choice_prompt:17:1221011013.text: I... what did I wish for?

say:18:1221011014:0.text: Uh... I suppose I did, but it was purely out of sympathy.
say:18:1221011014:0.source_cn: 呃……我好像是有这么想过，但那只是出于同情罢了。
say:18:1221011014:0.male: Uh... I suppose I did, but it was purely out of sympathy.
say:18:1221011014:0.female: Uh... I suppose I did, but it was purely out of sympathy.

say:19:1221011019:0.text: By the way, you um... flowers... even though you're helping, why just heal his wounds? Can't you wake him up too?
say:19:1221011019:0.source_cn: 话说回来，呃……那什么花。就算你们要帮我，为什么只治好...

say:21:1221011021:0.text: Glimmerblooms, wake up medicine, can't make...

say:22:1221011022:0.text: Don't look at me! I only know how to haul things, not brew potions!
say:22:1221011022:0.source_cn: 你们、你们不要看我啊！我只知道卖力气搬东西，烹饪和炼药...

say:23:1221011023:0.text: How about you? Do you know how to do this? Give me a hand!
say:23:1221011023:0.source_cn: 你们呢？知道怎么做吗？帮帮忙吧！

choice_prompt:24:1221011023.text: How about you? Do you know how to do this? Give me a hand!
choice_prompt:24:1221011023.source_cn: 你们呢？知道怎么做吗？帮帮忙吧！

say:25:1221011024:0.text: Thanks! You're way more dependable than the Whispers!
say:25:1221011024:0.source_cn: 谢了！你比刚刚那几个血薇帮的家伙可靠！
say:25:1221011024:0.male: Thanks! You're way more dependable than the Whispers!
say:25:1221011024:0.female: Thanks! You're way more dependable than the Whispers!

say:29:1221011025:0.text: Let's talk after I get the injured guy back and clear my name; I have nothing to offer right now.
say:29:1221011025:0.source_cn: 等带着伤员回去，证明了我的清白再说吧，我现在也拿不出什...
say:29:1221011025:0.male: Let's talk after I get the injured guy back and clear my name; I have nothing to offer right now.
say:29:1221011025:0.female: Let's talk after I get the injured guy back and clear my name; I have nothing to offer right now.

say:30:1221011026:0.text: In any case, let's prepare the potion. Saving him is what matters!
say:30:1221011026:0.source_cn: 不管怎么样，先把药做出来吧。救人要紧！
say:30:1221011026:0.male: In any case, let's prepare the potion. Saving him is what matters!
say:30:1221011026:0.female: In any case, let's prepare the potion. Saving him is what matters!

choice:24:1:2.text: How do you plan on thanking me?
choice:24:1:2.male: How do you plan on thanking me?
choice:24:1:2.female: How do you plan on thanking me?

choice:17:0:1.text: Wished for the injured to heal?
choice:17:0:1.male: Wished for the injured to heal?
choice:17:0:1.female: Wished for the injured to heal?

say:32:1221011015:0.text: So, he entered the forest to find the member of the Carmine Whispers. The glimmerblooms really helped!
say:32:1221011015:0.source_cn: 这么说来，他进入森林就是为了找血薇帮的人。荧荧花真的帮...
say:32:1221011015:0.male: So, he entered the forest to find the member of the Carmine Whispers. The glimmerblooms really helped!
say:32:1221011015:0.female: So, he entered the forest to find the member of the Carmine Whispers. The glimmerblooms really helped!

say:33:1221011016:0.text: Yeah! Find him! Let him heal!

say:34:1221011017:0.text: Wow, these glimmerblooms really know what you're thinking!
say:34:1221011017:0.source_cn: 哇，这些荧荧花真的知道你在想什么！

say:35:1221011018:1.text: That's only natural, right? He's severely injured—who would wish him harm?
say:35:1221011018:1.source_cn: ……这很正常吧。他都重伤成这样了，难不成还盼着他出事吗？

choice:17:1:2.text: You tried to find the injured?
choice:17:1:2.male: You tried to find the injured?
choice:17:1:2.female: You tried to find the injured?

say:38:1221011007:0.text: From the look of it, that seems to be the case.
say:38:1221011007:0.source_cn: 看现在的情况，确实是这样呢。
say:38:1221011007:0.male: From the look of it, that seems to be the case.
say:38:1221011007:0.female: From the look of it, that seems to be the case.

choice:6:1:2.source_cn: 难道是荧荧花治好了他？

narration:0:1221011101:1.text: The injured Carmine Whispers member is given the potion...

document:0:43:0.text: Grind the <style="highlight">jolly clams</style> and crush the <style="highlight">foxtail grass</style>, then add them to the <style="highlight">awakening essence</style> from the glimmerbloom. Mix it well, let it settle, and then strain.
document:0:43:0.source_cn: 将研磨后的<style="highlight">笑口贝</style>、打碎的<style="highlight">狸尾草</style>放入荧荧花提供的<style="highlight">苏醒药原液</style>，均匀混合后静置，再过滤掉沉淀的浑浊物。
document:0:43:0.male: Grind the <style="highlight">jolly clams</style> and crush the <style="highlight">foxtail grass</style>, then add them to the <style="highlight">awakening essence</style> from the glimmerbloom. Mix it well, let it settle, and then strain.
document:0:43:0.female: Grind the <style="highlight">jolly clams</style> and crush the <style="highlight">foxtail grass</style>, then add them to the <style="highlight">awakening essence</style> from the glimmerbloom. Mix it well, let it settle, and then strain.

say:10:1221011202:0.source_cn: 喝了，眼睛会睁开，病会好！

say:12:1221011203:0.text: This... this remedy is incredible! Will it really work?
say:12:1221011203:0.source_cn: 这……这药也太神奇了！真的会有用吗？

say:14:1221011204:0.text: Judging by the herbs and the way it was prepared, there shouldn't be any issues.
say:14:1221011204:0.source_cn: 从用的药草和制作方法上看，应该没什么问题。

say:15:1221011205:0.text: Just let him drink it down!
say:15:1221011205:0.source_cn: 总之，先让伤员喝下它吧！

say:1:1221012001:1.text: Ugh... wh-where am I? Am I still alive...?
say:1:1221012001:1.source_cn: 呃啊……这、这是哪？我还活着吗……

say:4:1221012003:1.text: A t-talking plant! I must be dreaming... am I already...?
say:4:1221012003:1.source_cn: 会……会说话的植物！我一定在做梦……难道我已经……

say:6:1221012004:1.text: Don't worry! You're fine now, and your wounds are healed!
say:6:1221012004:1.source_cn: 别紧张！你已经没事了，连身上的伤都好了！

say:7:1221012005:1.text: These glimmerblooms saved you, so there's no need to fear them!
say:7:1221012005:1.source_cn: 是这些荧荧花救了你，所以你不用害怕它们！

say:8:1221012006:1.text: They saved me? This is like something out of a fairy tale...
say:8:1221012006:1.source_cn: 它们救了我……？这，这简直像是讲给小孩的冒险故事一样。

say:9:1221012007:0.text: Um, in any case, thank you... You're called glimmerblooms, right?
say:9:1221012007:0.source_cn: 呃，总之要谢谢你们……是叫荧荧花来着吧？

say:12:1221012009:1.source_cn: 荧荧花是，帮他，实现心愿！

say:14:1221012010:0.text: ...Hold on! Don't start pointing at me again!

say:16:1221012011:0.text: A Wight? What's a Wight doing here?!
say:16:1221012011:0.source_cn: 水鬼？！怎么水鬼也在这里？！

say:17:1221012012:0.text: What, I'm not good enough for a deserted island? This place isn't in the Whispers' territory!
say:17:1221012012:0.source_cn: 怎么，我待在这里不行吗？这座岛又不是你们血薇帮的地盘！

say:18:1221012013:0.text: I'm just an unlucky guy falsely accused by your companion and forced to come out and find you!
say:18:1221012013:0.source_cn: 至于我——是一个被你的同伴误会、被迫出来找你的倒霉蛋！

say:22:1221012015:0.text: Yes! And the glimmerblooms said they healed your wounds because he wished for you to recover!
say:22:1221012015:0.source_cn: 没错！而且荧荧花说，是因为他希望你能尽快好起来，所以才...

say:23:1221012018:0.text:
The glimmerblooms healed me thanks to him...?
This doesn't sound right...
say:23:1221012018:0.source_cn: 因为他，所以这些荧荧花治好了我……？\n听起来好像不太...

say:25:1221012019:0.text: But since Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> said so, I have no reason to doubt it.
say:25:1221012019:0.male: But since Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> said so, I have no reason to doubt it.
say:25:1221012019:0.female: But since Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> said so, I have no reason to doubt it.

say:27:1221012021:0.text: Alright, alright, as long as everything's fine.

say:28:1221012022:0.text: Hurry and come back with me to <style="highlight">the coast</style>. I'm still waiting for you to clear my name! Your Whispers brothers are still looking for you.

say:30:1221012023:1.source_cn: 你们要，回去了？那，再见！再见！

say:31:1221012024:1.text: Farewell. I'll remember your kindness, little ones.
say:31:1221012024:1.source_cn: 再见了。我会记住你们的恩情的，小家伙。

say:34:1221012016:1.text: The one you should be thanking is this Water Wight! He asked the Magister to help make the awakening elixir to get you on your feet.
say:34:1221012016:1.source_cn: 你最该感谢的其实是你面前的这个水鬼帮！为了让你快点醒过...
say:34:1221012016:1.male: The one you should be thanking is this Water Wight! He asked the Magister to help make the awakening elixir to get you on your feet.
say:34:1221012016:1.female: The one you should be thanking is this Water Wight! He asked the Magister to help make the awakening elixir to get you on your feet.

say:35:1221012017:1.text: And the glimmerblooms healed your wounds thanks to his wish for your speedy recovery!
say:35:1221012017:1.source_cn: 而且你身上的伤，也是因为他希望你能尽快康复，这些荧荧花...

choice:20:1:2.text: Don't thank me, just pay me.
choice:20:1:2.source_cn: 不用谢我，我救人是要收钱的
choice:20:1:2.male: Don't thank me, just pay me.
choice:20:1:2.female: Don't thank me, just pay me.

say:0:1221012101:0.text: Can you walk? I need to get you back quickly or I'll never clear my name!
say:0:1221012101:0.source_cn: 能走路吗？我得赶紧带你回去，要不然跳进海里都洗不清了！

say:1:1221013001:1.text: Elwood?! Am I seeing things? You're awake... and you're walking!
say:1:1221013001:1.source_cn: 埃尔伍？！我不是看错了吧！你居然醒过来了……而且还能走路！

say:2:1221013002:1.text: Where were you? How did you recover?! Is there a physician hiding in a cave on this island?!
say:2:1221013002:1.source_cn: 你刚才去哪了？怎么好起来的？！难道这岛上有位隐居的名医？！

say:4:1221013003:1.text: *Sigh* It's a long story, and even I don't fully understand it.
say:4:1221013003:1.source_cn: 唉，这就说来话长了，连我自己也没太搞明白。

say:5:1221013004:0.text: Would you mind explaining what happened?
say:5:1221013004:0.source_cn: 能麻烦您帮我解释一下都发生了什么吗？
say:5:1221013004:0.male: Would you mind explaining what happened?
say:5:1221013004:0.female: Would you mind explaining what happened?

choice_prompt:6:1221013004.text: Would you mind explaining what happened?
choice_prompt:6:1221013004.source_cn: 能麻烦您帮我解释一下都发生了什么吗？
choice_prompt:6:1221013004.male: Would you mind explaining what happened?
choice_prompt:6:1221013004.female: Would you mind explaining what happened?

say:7:1221013005:1.text: Yes, that's exactly what happened. Strange as it sounds, my wounds are fully healed, without a single scar to show for them.
say:7:1221013005:1.source_cn: 没错，就是这样。虽然这件事听起来很诡异，但我身上的伤确...

say:8:1221013006:1.text: If things are really as you say, this island is indeed bizarre... but out at sea, anything is possible.
say:8:1221013006:1.source_cn: 要是真像你们说的那样，这座岛也太古怪了……不过大海之上...

say:9:1221013007:0.text: By the way, I still haven't thanked you, Master Mage.
say:9:1221013007:0.source_cn: 对了，还没来得及和您道谢，魔法师大人。
say:9:1221013007:0.male: By the way, I still haven't thanked you, Master Mage.
say:9:1221013007:0.female: By the way, I still haven't thanked you, Master Mage.

choice_prompt:10:1221013007.text: By the way, I still haven't thanked you, Master Mage.
choice_prompt:10:1221013007.source_cn: 对了，还没来得及和您道谢，魔法师大人。
choice_prompt:10:1221013007.male: By the way, I still haven't thanked you, Master Mage.
choice_prompt:10:1221013007.female: By the way, I still haven't thanked you, Master Mage.

say:11:1221013010:0.text: And to the Water Wight lad... my thanks to you too.
say:11:1221013010:0.source_cn: 那位水鬼帮小哥……也谢谢你了。

say:12:1221013011:0.text: I was wrong to suspect you before. I shouldn't have let the rivalry between the Whispers and Wights color my view of you. I'm sorry.
say:12:1221013011:0.source_cn: 之前误会你藏起了他，是我的错。我不该带着偏见，带着血薇...

say:14:1221013012:0.text: Hmph... forget it, it's not a big deal.
say:14:1221013012:0.source_cn: 哼……算了，也不是什么大事。

say:15:1221013013:0.text: The injured are back unharmed, the misunderstanding has been cleared up, and everything is settled.
say:15:1221013013:0.source_cn: 伤员能平安无事地回来，误会也解开了，这件事就算圆满解决。

say:16:1221013014:0.text: Even though we're on opposite sides now, I would never retaliate because of the feud between our gangs—especially not on an injured person!
say:16:1221013014:0.source_cn: 虽然我们现在阵营不同，但我绝对不会因为两个帮派之间的敌...

say:19:1221013008:0.text: Naturally, I'll file a report and apply for your reward.
say:19:1221013008:0.source_cn: 当然，我会把这件事报告上去，申请给您的酬金。
say:19:1221013008:0.male: Naturally, I'll file a report and apply for your reward.
say:19:1221013008:0.female: Naturally, I'll file a report and apply for your reward.

choice:10:1:2.source_cn: 比起感谢，我更想要酬劳

choice:10:2:3.text: One more person you should thank.
choice:10:2:3.source_cn: 还有一个人，你也该谢谢他
choice:10:2:3.male: One more person you should thank.
choice:10:2:3.female: One more person you should thank.

cinematic_dialogue:1:1221005001:.text: —It's you! Where have you taken the injured person?!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1221005001:.source_cn: ——是你们！你们把伤员带到哪里了？！

cinematic_dialogue:1:1221005002:.text: What do you want?! Keep away from me!!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1221005002:.source_cn: 你们想干什么？！离我远点！！

cinematic_dialogue:1:1221005003:.text: Oh no! He's been captured by the glimmerblooms!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1221005003:.source_cn: 不好了！他被荧荧花抓走了！
